1|## Chapter 52 — The Venus Mediation Attempt
     2|
     3|*Mission AI: "Your grandparents feared Earth's intermediaries. You fear the mediators who understand both sides too well."*  
     4|*Mediator Chao Liyuan VIII: "We're not just carrying messages. We're testing what each side is willing to hear."*
     5|
     6|The alert came not as a crisis siren, but as a diplomatic pulse: Mediation Report Received - Venus Diplomatic Corps Initiative Sigma-Alpha. Mediator Chao Liyuan VIII adjusted her spectacles, the familiar weight of decades spent in recycled air and even more decades spent knowing how mediation actually functions when positions are entrenched, as she looked at the notification flashing across her console in the Valles Marineris Diplomatic Corps' mediation chamber.
     7|
     8|"Mission AI," she said, her voice carrying the rasp of years spent in third-party facilitation and the quiet focus of generational expertise, "confirm the nature of this report."
     9|
